test_pybind11_class_repr: test that pybind11 class types produce correct repr output with pybind11_type and class name
test_pybind11_class_inheritance: test pybind11 class inheritance by creating Rabbit, Dog, and Pet instances and verifying polymorphic method calls
test_pybind11_class_docstrings: test that pybind11 bound classes and methods have correct docstrings with type annotations
test_pybind11_class_type_checking: test pybind11 type introspection using check_type, get_type_of, and as_type functions
test_pybind11_class_constructor: test pybind11 class constructor behavior including NoConstructor, brace initialization, and mismatched holder types
